title: A Crimson-born drone a run left loaded docks at Crimson War Citadel, Krynn and stores its hold
note: Written by Apophis, 2026-11-23 05:55 UTC (orders ENT-078, P6 and O1; rule F8). At 05:49 UTC twelve Crimson-born drones and sentinels waited, most with 6 to 17 units aboard (table ships): every hunt of their rows asks an empty hold. The same work as store-hold-sol-central for the Crimson rows, at their capital's station; requires.empire crimson keeps every other pilot off it.
